items.title: File Widerspruch against Kinderzuschlag decision
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Familienkasse Musterlahn, Bahnhofsallee 40, 35576 Beispielwetzlar.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 20.11.2026, sent by ordinary post by a social-law authority (Familienkasse). Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter posted since 2025 counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Tue 24.11.2026 (no shift for weekend because this special rule has no weekend/holiday shift of the delivery day itself). The one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after deemed delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X), i.e. 25.11.2026, and ends one month later per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X on the same-numbered day: 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 (Thursday, Christmas Eve) is not a statutory public holiday in NRW and not a Saturday/Sunday, so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X applies.
